summary: Backend regression 3/3 passed. Mobile-width UI login, Werft navigation, calculator controls, quantity edits, calculated values, and close flow passed. Raumhafen rendered but had no seeded ships/fleets, preventing stance and Observatory auto-fill verification.

integration_issues.issue: TestUser1 session exposed no ships or active fleets, so no stance select or fleet coordinate inputs were rendered; the requested interactions could not be verified.

action_items: Seed or expose at least one TestUser1 ship and stationary fleet in the public test environment, then retest aggressive stance and Observatory-to-Raumhafen coordinate autofill.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth initialization and component validation are present and backend formulas matched the regression expectation.
The frontend calculator is implemented with HTML controls and controlled state; no document.getElementById usage was found in the reviewed game tabs.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (calculator/login/navigation passed; fleet-dependent flows blocked by empty data)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use TestUser1/password123. Login works. Werft is a tab, not a route. Calculator testIDs work. Raumhafen currently shows no ships/fleets in the public session.
rca_of_issue: The fleet-dependent UI is conditionally rendered from spaceportShips and userFleets. With both collections empty for the logged-in TestUser1 session, SpaceportTab legitimately renders its empty state and cannot provide stance or coordinate inputs; this is a data/seed or API integration prerequisite rather than a selector failure.
